description: A polyphonic multisample player: it reads an SFZ or DecentSampler instrument from disk and plays it back with up to sixteen voices, with velocity layers, round-robins and loops

params.text: Picks which of the loaded instruments is played
Sets the output level, silence to twice

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, a volt per octave; the number of channels here is what sets the polyphony, up to sixteen voices
A rise starts a note on that channel and a fall releases it
Sets how hard each note is struck, 0-10V read as 1 to 127, which sets the voice's level and picks the velocity layer
Picks the instrument, added to the instrument knob
Scales the output level, added to the level knob

outputs.text: The left side of the sounding voices
The right side of the sounding voices

notes: the module makes no sound until an instrument is loaded from the menu; more than one can be held at once and switched between by knob or CV
a one-channel cable in the velocity jack is broadcast to every voice, so one velocity cable covers a whole chord rather than leaving the voices after the first silent
notes are pitched by resampling from each region's own centre note, with a short attack and release on every voice so the note edges do not click
menu: Load instrument (.sfz / .dspreset / .dsbundle / .dslibrary)… — reads an instrument file and adds it to the list, which is saved with the patch
Load DecentSampler bundle (folder)… — reads a DecentSampler instrument from an unpacked folder
Remove current instrument — drops the selected instrument from the list
One-shot (play through, ignore gate-off) — lets each sample run to its natural end whatever the gate does, which suits drums and other play-through material
Amp envelope: Off (fast release), Use envelopes (SFZ), Default ADSR (smooth) — chooses whether the voice takes its shape from the instrument file, from a built-in envelope, or has almost none
Grid view — a label over the grid items below it
Layout: Chromatic (4ths), In-Key (scale), Chromatic grid (C0) — sets how the notes are laid out across the pad grid
Root — sets the root the In-Key layout is drawn from
Scale (In-Key) — sets the scale the In-Key layout is drawn from
Octave up — moves the pad grid an octave higher
Octave down — moves the pad grid an octave lower

inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic
